author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Single-stroke pretzel on SQUARE, mirrored: outer loop with r8 humps and a broad round bottom; arms cross at the top dip at 90 degrees, form a 9-wide lens (double twist), cross again and fold down at 45 degrees as tails resting on the loop. Reads as a pretzel at 48, both themes. No Lucide pretzel; construction from Lucide-style cubics.
omissions: Rope thickness (outlined tube) and over/under crossing order not shown; single strokes cross at shared nodes.
